title: Extending HDB's Deferred Downpayment Scheme to 4-room and 5-room BTO Flats
what_it_is: Extending HDB's Deferred Downpayment Scheme to 4-room and 5-room BTO Flats

sections.label: HDB downpayment schemes for seniors
sections.summary: Deferred Downpayment helps seniors aged 55 and above buying uncompleted 2-room flexi or 3-room flats, while Staggered Downpayment applies to other buyers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Deferred downpayment is a specific scheme for seniors and it is meant to facilitate the right-sizing process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Specifically, elderly flat owners aged 55 and above who are buying an uncompleted 2-room flexi or 3-room flat from HDB may apply for this Deferred Downpayment Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Separately, HDB also has a Staggered Downpayment Scheme (SDS) where flat buyers are required to pay half of the downpayment when they sign the Agreement for Lease and pay the other half together with the balance purchase price at key collection.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This SDS is available to first-timer young couples below the age of 30.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They can qualify for such a scheme when they buy any flat type from HDB, including 4-room and 5-room flat types.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: SDS is also available to flat owners who are rightsizing to a 2-room flexi or a 3-room flat in non-mature estates, regardless of the age of the flat owner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Home seekers should continue to exercise financial prudence and buy a flat within their means.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And for those who face difficulties with their downpayment, HDB can provide assistance on a case-by-case basis.

sections.label: Purpose of downpayment policy
sections.summary: A downpayment policy is wanted so potential flat buyers take the purchase of their flat seriously.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Why do you need a downpayment in such cases?

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we do want a downpayment policy and we want potential flat buyers to take the purchase of their flat seriously.
